title: SmooHUD Dark Selector
description: Just the dark hotbar selector from SmooHUD Dark
body:
# SmooHUD Dark Selector

This resource pack merely contains the selected hotbar slot icon texture from SmooHUD Dark. Right now this is pretty useless as there is only one colour variant of SmooHUD, but in the future I intend (but do not promise) to create SmooHUD in more colour schemes, and if that happens you'll be able to mix and match any SmooHUD colour variant with any SmooHUD Selector variant.

Add this pack __above__ SmooHUD in the resource pack selection screen!

## SmooPacks

Check out all currently available SmooHUD Selectors in the [SmooHUD Selector Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/eRZkOenV).


If you want to smoothen the rest of your HUD as well, download any of the [SmooHUD Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/R1YmDDaC).


If you want to have a smooth options background, download any of the [SmooBack Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/VZGPEYKa).


If you want to overhaul the rest of your GUI in the same style as SmooHUD, download any of the [SmooGUI Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/QRoetCy4).
